summary: Iteration-10 (admin trip editing + offline mark-paid). BACKEND 20/20 PASSED (/app/backend/tests/test_sidra_iter10_admin_edit.py): joshua@flysidra.com is_admin=true; member gets 403 on /details, /guests, /mark-paid; POST /api/admin/quotes/{id}/details updates route/jet/jet_name/trip_type/dates/window/pax and recalculates estimate, distance_nm etc. (matches /quotes/estimate); one_way clears return_date; validations: pax>seats ('seats up to 12'), return before depart, missing return date, same origin/dest, unknown jet -> 400, pax < manifest count -> 400, bad date format -> 422; PUT /api/admin/quotes/{id}/guests saves manifest (passport uppercased) visible to member, too many guests / passport expiry / future DOB -> 400; mark-paid on Requested -> 400, invalid method -> 422, Confirmed+final price -> paid with method, trimmed reference, invoice_number SID-YYYY-XXXXXX, second call -> 409; member GET shows paid, invoice-link PDF says 'Amount paid by bank transfer' and the final price; confirm endpoint after paid -> 400 (price locked) while details stay editable; cancelled trip -> 400 for details/guests/mark-paid; unknown id -> 404. FRONTEND (390x844): joshua login -> Profile shows 'SIDRA TEAM' badge -> Team dashboard opens; team/[id] shows Payment cell 'Unpaid', Edit trip + Edit manifest buttons and 'Paid outside the app?' section; /team/edit/[id] airport picker (search LBG) + aircraft G650ER + Return + date fields (auto-format) + Evening chip + pax stepper; invalid return date shows inline server error; valid save returns to request screen with DXB->LBG, G650ER, Evening, Jan 15, 5 guests; /trip/guests/[id]?team=1 calls PUT /api/admin/quotes/{id}/guests, shows admin intro, hides saved traveller picker, saves and returns; Mark as paid (Wire transfer + reference) shows 'Paid in full' block with invoice no., Payment cell 'Paid · Wire transfer · ref', offline section removed; member trip shows trip-paid-banner + invoice button, invoice PDF says 'wire transfer'. One business-logic gap: editing route/aircraft of an already Confirmed trip keeps the old final_price_usd (seen: estimate $182,600 vs final $57,100, then marked paid at $57,100). Deprecated packages: none detected in touched files.

minor.issue: On a Confirmed (unpaid) trip, changing route/jet/trip_type keeps the old final_price_usd and Confirmed status. The member can then pay (Stripe or offline) the stale price. Reproduced: DXB->LTN Challenger 650 confirmed $57,100 -> edited to DXB->LBG G650ER return (estimate $182,600), final stayed $57,100.
Changing dates does not re-validate existing manifest passports against the new last travel day (_check_guests not re-run), and manifest_reminder_sent_at is not reset when depart_date moves.
No member notification/email when the team changes trip details (member only sees it in-app).

issues: Pay-method / window / trip-type chips are 40px high (below 44px touch target)
Edit screen error text renders at the bottom of the scroll content; visible here but could be off-screen on smaller devices
No warning on Edit trip that final price is NOT recalculated for confirmed trips
Guest DOB / passport expiry shown via formatDate without year (e.g. 'Born Tue, Jan 1') - year is essential for DOB/passport expiry (pre-existing)

action_items: When admin edits route/jet/trip_type on a Confirmed unpaid trip, either reset status to Requested + clear final_price_usd, or require/offer a new final price (at minimum warn in the edit screen).
Optionally re-run _check_guests on details edit when dates change, and reset manifest_reminder_sent_at if depart_date changes.
Minor: bump chips to minHeight 44; show year for DOB/passport expiry in team manifest.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_mark_paid uses an atomic find_one_and_update with payment_status $ne paid -> correct 409 on double submit.
admin_save_guests writes the guests into the trip owner's saved travellers (_save_travellers(doc.user_id)) - intended, but means admin edits mutate the member's address book.
_editable_doc correctly blocks cancelled trips for details/guests/mark-paid.
Email provider returned 429 rate limit during test bursts; endpoints degrade gracefully (email_status 'Receipt email failed').
